text:
**The parts that bite back**

Most people who want this also fight it — you're in ordinary company. I need the map of your recoil: what I'm handling, and how carefully.

prompt: How well do you know each of these?
hint: Whatever sits high on this list is live wire — it decides how carefully I handle you.
choices: The urge to purge — delete it all, throw it out
Soft purging — quietly thinning things out
Fear of where this is going
Guilt toward the people in my life

prompt: And when it hits — what do you actually do?
hint: I time my pushes and my patience around this — the pattern matters as much as the feelings.
choices: Ride it out — it fades on its own
Purge — throw it out, delete it all, quit
Suppress — lock it down for weeks
Cycle — quit and come back hungrier each time
Lean in — the recoil only feeds it
